primary_meaning: Jesus Christ as the personal embodiment and full revelation of divine truth

alternatives.meaning: The written Word of God / Holy Scripture as reliable divine revelation
The Holy Spirit as the Spirit of truth who guides into all truth
The gospel message and apostolic teaching / Christian doctrine
God's own character of faithfulness, reliability, and covenant loyalty
Moral integrity, honesty, or upright conduct in human life

notes: Across mainstream Christian interpretation the term 'the truth' is most strongly and distinctively linked to the person of Christ (especially via the Johannine corpus), with secondary but still widespread associations to Scripture, the Spirit, the gospel, and God's faithfulness. These readings are complementary rather than mutually exclusive in classical theology; no major competing symbolic system displaces the Christological primary.
